_comment: Hooks for angular-plugin. PostToolUse: format and lint changed TS/HTML/SCSS/CSS files via ESLint + Prettier when present. Skips silently when not configured.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.ts|*.html|*.scss|*.css|*.js|*.mts|*.cts|*.mjs|*.cjs) [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"prettier"' package.json 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"eslint"' package.json 2>/dev/null && npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/config-protection.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" 'eslint.config.js' '.eslintrc*' 'tsconfig.json' 'tsconfig.app.json' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (eslint.config.js;.eslintrc*;tsconfig.json;tsconfig.app.json;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 's=""; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; elif [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/post-implement-check.sh"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Silent when the tool is absent or no run is active.
